# Braincuber Technologies

> > AI-first technology partner specializing in enterprise AI solutions, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), Odoo ERP implementation, and custom software development.

Braincuber Technologies is a tech consultancy with 57+ experts delivering AI automation, custom ERP systems (particularly Odoo), and digital transformation solutions. They focus on measurable ROI, offering solutions that reduce costs by 30-40% across AI implementation, ERP development, and business process automation.
